## Checklist

- [ ] The resource is operator-focused — something a store owner can learn from, use, or buy.
- [ ] Added to the most relevant section, in alphabetical or ranked order.
- [ ] Entry follows the format: `- [Name](url) - Description ending with a period.`
- [ ] Description is neutral and factual — no marketing hype or exclamation marks.
- [ ] No duplicate of an existing entry.
- [ ] Link is the canonical homepage/repository (no affiliate or tracking URLs).
